status: post-outcome diagnostic frozen before independent path validation
purpose: compare the primary SciPy two-layer rail-required shortest-path implementation against an independent NetworkX implementation
states: 2017 baseline plus each 2018-2024 full year-end event coalition

sampling.station_pairs: uniform pseudorandom distinct active station-occurrence pairs without replacement, independent of computed distances
sampling.origins: active origin IDs sorted by SHA-256 of seed, year and grid ID; first 64
sampling.destinations: one active destination per selected origin by SHA-256 modulus over sorted active destination IDs

interpretation: numerical implementation validation only; does not validate historical service assumptions or observed travel times
